events.outcome: Current Fortress FAQ establishes 365-day validity after activation and another 365 days after a top-up of at least HKD10. Current FAQ also documents real-name registration, physical-SIM-only service, voice/SMS behavior and number-recycling caveats; 2026 community users continue to report HK retail availability and HKD10 annual maintenance.

data.acquisitionSummary: Fortress sells haha SIM through Hong Kong Fortress stores/eStore. Current community users in 2026 report straightforward Fortress retail availability and a typical HKD50 card purchase, but the official FAQ rather than seller/community price claims controls lifecycle facts.

keep.action: Top up HKD10 or more before expiry. Current Fortress FAQ says each qualifying top-up automatically extends SIM validity by 365 days; buying a data package does not extend validity.

data.chinaActivation: Current provider FAQ does not establish a guaranteed mainland-China-first activation path. It states activation occurs when the physical SIM is inserted and activation SMS/number are received; local Hong Kong use requires real-name registration. Preserve overseas-use reports as community evidence rather than a provider guarantee.
data.kyc: Current Fortress FAQ requires real-name registration information including HKID or travel-document details for applicable registration flows. Do not promote community no-KYC workarounds as a supported route.
data.payment: Top-up is managed through the haha TRAVEL App; foreign-card or mainland payment acceptance is not provider-guaranteed in the reviewed material.
data.roamingSms: Current provider FAQ supports roaming text/voice subject to account balance and charges. 2026 community users report mainland-China SMS reception, but service-specific OTP success is not guaranteed; Fortress also warns that recycled numbers can retain third-party platform history.
data.refund: Expired lines may be considered for reactivation within 14 days; approval is not guaranteed and real-name registration may need to be completed again.
data.tariffSummary: HKD10-or-more top-up extends SIM validity by 365 days. Physical SIM only; real-name registration rules and third-party platform/recycled-number risk remain material.
guideSteps: Acquire a current physical haha SIM from Fortress.
Complete the applicable real-name registration flow; do not rely on no-KYC workarounds.
Top up at least HKD10 before the 365-day deadline and treat platform OTP acceptance as evidence-scoped.
